description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface, which specifies a contract for logging components in an Android logging system. It includes a method 'println' for outputting log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain that can output log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
